workflows.name: bounded shared-fsync group commit with per-transaction outcomes

workflows.name: confirmation ledger reconciliation across restart

workflows.name: uncertain sync fails closed with bounded queue
workflows.entry: commit under induced journal write failure
workflows.success: sync failure returns 503 and stops service; restart reconciles each independent transaction
workflows.failure: no optimistic success, no unbounded queue; oversized frame is a 429 that does not poison the journal
